# structural_budget_golden.txt — the debt ledger for test/architecture/structural_budget_test.go.
#
# Only entities ALREADY over threshold are listed, so this file is a list of debts, not an
# inventory. Both directions of drift fail: growth demands a hand edit plus a justification in
# the commit message, shrinkage demands `go test ./test/architecture/ -update-structural-budget`
# so the improvement is locked in and cannot silently become slack.
#
# thresholds: type-methods > 40 methods, pkg-files > 20 files, pkg-code-lines > 2000
# code lines. The two code-line dimensions are quantised DOWN (pkg-code-lines to 2000,
# main-noncli-code-lines to 100) so ordinary commits are invisible and only crossing a boundary
# is an event. main-noncli-code-lines has no lower threshold: it is always tracked.
#
# NOTE: -update-structural-budget only ever TIGHTENS. It refuses to write a value wider than the
# one already here, and it refuses to admit a NEW over-budget entity at all, which is what makes
# running it a safe routine action.
# ==== everything below this line is hand-written and survives regeneration ====
# main-noncli-code-lines: non-CLI logic trapped in package main (L03-F6), comment-stripped.
#
# HISTORY. This shipped as an EXACT line count and was raised twice by hand inside the increment that
# introduced it, 1102 -> 1106 -> 1116:
#
# +4  the missing natsconf.TopoBehind branch in cluster_status_card.go plus the explicit non-degrading
#     case in cluster_doctor_online.go. TopoBehind degrades, so the cluster was already being reported
#     unhealthy while the card that says WHY produced nothing.
# +10 the line-2 §12 Y2 error-code split: hints and exit classes for pty_unavailable,
#     attach_subscribe_failed, download_http_status and download_too_large. Those tables live in
#     error_hints.go, which does not import cobra and so counts as non-CLI. The alternative to paying
#     ten lines here was leaving `tether node upgrade` against a typo'd URL retried forever.
#
# Both raises bought an operator a stated cause where they previously got silence — the trade this
# ledger exists to make VISIBLE, not to forbid. But two hand-raises for +4 and +10 lines of ordinary
# work is also the review's PI-9 finding: at that grain the gate reddens on everything and teaches
# people to run `-update` without reading. Hence the quantum of 100.
#
# The value moved 1116 -> 1100 for two reasons at once, both from the line-2 review:
#   PI-2  the classifier stopped exempting files by SUBSTRING and now parses the import list, which
#         added cmd/tether/poll.go (44 code lines, discusses cobra in prose, imports nothing of the
#         sort — previously exempt from the one dimension meant to catch it). Measured, not argued:
#         with the substring classifier restored, appending the single comment line
#         "// The cobra command tree wires this in" to error_hints.go drops the total 1160 -> 800,
#         and the failure that produces says "DEBT SHRANK, run -update" — so one comment line, plus
#         the command the gate itself tells you to run, permanently removes a 360-line file from the
#         budget. Parsing imports: same probe, no change.
#   PI-9  quantisation to 100. Raw is 1160; 1160 rounded down is 1100.
main-noncli-code-lines cmd/tether 1200
# pkg-code-lines: the FOURTH dimension, added during line-2's own review (plan §11 X2 re-adjudicated).
#
# X2 had rejected S3's pkg-lines forever, on the condition that it be reopened if someone found a
# comment-immune package-size measure AND showed pkg-files missing real growth. Both were true inside the
# same change: countCodeLines is that measure, and a review lane appended 1082 lines of real code to
# internal/broker/loopset.go with every gate green. type-methods and pkg-files are both blind to growth
# INSIDE existing files -- which is the cheapest thing to do and the thing CLAUDE.md's "prefer merging
# into an existing file" rule actively recommends. A ratchet whose only gap is the path of least
# resistance shapes behaviour toward god files.
#
# These five lines are a FIRST REGISTRATION, not a raise: the dimension did not exist before, so there is
# no earlier value to compare against. Values are code lines rounded DOWN to 2000 so ordinary commits are
# invisible and only crossing a boundary is an event. -update-structural-budget refuses to admit a new
# over-budget entity on its own (see GI-4), which is why these were typed here by hand.
pkg-code-lines cmd/tether 10000
pkg-code-lines internal/agent 4000
pkg-code-lines internal/broker 14000
pkg-code-lines internal/cluster 2000
pkg-code-lines internal/clusteroffline 2000
pkg-files cmd/tether 56
pkg-files internal/broker 70
pkg-files internal/cluster 32
type-methods internal/agent.Agent 127
type-methods internal/broker.Broker 285
type-methods internal/broker.ClusterAdmin 86
